title: A small Pentagon group dealt with the tall whites, whose base was like a foreign embassy

tellings.quote: The Pentagon had a tiny handful of people that knew they that interacted with them.

plain: In the 1960s only a tiny handful of people at the Pentagon knew about, and dealt with, the "Tall Whites," tall pale beings said to live at a base on the Air Force ranges near Nellis and Indian Springs in Nevada, a base treated much like a foreign embassy. That is what Charles Hall tells Michels; Hall says he spent three years with these beings while stationed there, and says "the Pentagon had a tiny handful of people that knew" and "interacted with them." If true, the US government kept quiet, diplomatic contact with an alien group.
